note: Japanese passport holders enjoy extensive visa-free access worldwide, including all G7 countries.
German passport allows access to almost all European and many Asian countries without a visa.
U.S. passport holders enjoy visa-free access to most countries in Europe, Asia, and the Americas.
Canadian citizens have visa-free or visa-on-arrival access to 186 countries and territories.
Turkish citizens can travel to many countries visa-free including Japan, South Korea, and most of South America.
China has been rapidly expanding its visa-free agreements with several countries in recent years.
Argentine passport grants visa-free access to much of Europe and Latin America.
Iranian citizens require visas for most western countries, with some visa-free options in neighboring regions.
South African passport is one of the strongest in Africa, with good access within the continent.
Switzerland's neutral status and strong economy contribute to its highly-ranked passport.
The Syrian passport currently has limited visa-free mobility due to ongoing regional instability.
